name: tg-corporate-income-tax
description: Togo corporate income tax reference for the 2026 tax year, covering ordinary companies and taxable entities, the territorial business test, taxable profit adjustments, loss carryforwards, the minimum forfaitaire de perception and annual filing. Use it for impôt sur les sociétés, IS, corporate profit, MFP, loss relief, GUDEF financial statements and instalment calculations. The Guide applies the enacted 2026 finance law to the consolidated tax code, including the shorter construction permanent establishment test and used vehicle minimum-tax rule. It distinguishes profit tax from turnover minimum tax, links distributions and associated-party transactions to dedicated Guides, and identifies special regimes and filing details that are outside the verified computation.
